snippet.title: Wolf of The Desert | Cyberpunk Stealth Action Trailer
snippet.description:
Checkout Wolf of The Desert on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3839400/WOLF_OF_THE_DESERT/
 
Ascend the neon-drenched skyline of Cyber Arabia in this 3rd-person stealth-action thriller. Infiltrate Qamaria Tower to dismantle a corrupt financial empire, find your missing brother, and master kinetic card-throwing by upgrading Sand Chips to vanish into smoke or unleash pyro explosions!

#WolfOfTheDesert #Cyberpunk #StealthGame #IndieGame #TacticalEspionage #GameTrailer #AJInteractive #UE5 #SciFi
